newsitem.title: INDIA: India's April finished steel output falls.
newsitem.headline: India's April finished steel output falls.

text.p: India produced 1.77 million tonnes of finished steel in April, down from 1.80 million tonnes in the same month last year, the goverment said on Wednesday.
The government said in a statement that the output of the main producers had declined by 8.8 percent.
However, production of pig iron was unchanged at 284,000 tonnes, it said.
"The apparent consumption of finished steel during April 1997 was 1.56 million tonnes, showing a decrease of 3.7 percent over the corresponding period last year," it said.
"The total export of finished steel during April 1997 has been estimated at 75,000 tonnes as against 105,000 tonnes during the last year, showing a decrease of 28.6 percent," it said.
Steel Authority of India Ltd produced 953,400 tonnes of hot metal, 835,300 tonnes of crude steel and 677,900 tonnes of saleable steel in April 1997, the statement said.
The firm's cumulative production of saleable steel dropped three percent to 703,500 tonnes, it said.
